A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same R-AdaZO research. Their main text, equations, figures, table, and Appendices A and B are readable and support reliable matching across revisions.

before.justification: Sections 6.1–6.3 report original synthetic optimization, MNIST adversarial attack, and SST-2 fine-tuning results in Figures 1–3 and Table 1.

after.justification: v2 retains original experiments and reports additional synthetic comparisons, COPA fine-tuning results, and an LLM momentum-sensitivity experiment.

M1.justification: Algorithm 2 retains the same gradient estimator, first-moment update, second moment based on squared first moments, and parameter update. The revised smoothing definition changes the theoretical analysis, not the optimization procedure.

E1.justification: Coverage expands to COPA causal reasoning alongside SST-2, and Cubic replaces Ackley among synthetic functions. Other application coverage remains. Levy was already evaluated in v1's Figure 1 and Appendix B.1 despite its inconsistent Rastrigin references in Section 6.1.

E2.justification: Figure 1 adds ZO-SGD and ZO-signSGD to ZO-RMSProp and ZO-AdaMM, substantially broadening the synthetic comparison from adaptive optimizers to include nonadaptive update rules. The adversarial-attack and LLM comparator sets remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Figure 1 extends the reported synthetic optimization horizon from approximately 10,000 to beyond 50,000 iterations. Figure 3(d) introduces a controlled comparison of beta1 values 0.3, 0.6, and 0.9. Retained experiments' listed metrics and Appendix B hyperparameters remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Figure 3(d) adds an analysis of how beta1 affects R-AdaZO training-loss convergence on OPT-1.3B and SST-2. This supplements the unchanged first- and second-moment sensitivity analyses on the Quadratic function in Figure 2.

E5.justification: Both versions report means over three independent runs for Figures 1 and 3, and means with standard deviations over five runs for Table 1. The added curves use the existing reporting practice; no new uncertainty-estimation or significance-testing procedure is reported.

E6.justification: Figure 1 adds baseline and Cubic results, removes Ackley results, and extends the synthetic trajectories. Figure 3 adds a reported 2.14× COPA speedup and momentum-sensitivity results. SST-2's 4.29× and 3.75× speedups and Table 1 remain unchanged. Longer synthetic horizons do not establish same-budget performance gains.

T1.justification: Equation (11) changes smoothing from the sphere to the ball, with corresponding proof revisions. Appendices A.7–A.8 revise mathematical reasoning, inequalities, dimension-dependent constants, and parameter choices. Appendix A.10 replaces the brief argument for Corollary 5.10 with supporting lemmas and a substantial derivation for the renamed Theorem 5.10.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list, and conclusion retain the same central claims about moment utilization, variance reduction, the variance-aware convergence framework, and superior convergence. Additional experiments support these existing contributions.

C2.justification: Section 5.3 qualifies the theoretical speedup as applying primarily when variance dominates and explains why larger beta1 can help. Section 6.1 softens uniformly lower-gap language to generally faster convergence with competitive gaps, while Section 6.3 connects the new momentum results to the theory.

D1.justification: Appendix B.1 replaces the Ackley objective specification with an explicit Cubic formula. Other implementation and hyperparameter disclosures remain unchanged. Appendix B.3 still describes SST-2 only and supplies no COPA-specific reproduction details.

R1.justification: v2 adds references to randomized smoothing by Duchi et al., ZO-signSGD, COPA, and RELiZO. It adds a short discussion of query-reusing linear interpolation and explicitly attributes randomized smoothing, while retaining the overall research positioning.

P1.justification: The section organization and most prose remain intact. Changes include localized theoretical explanations, an expanded adversarial-task introduction, corrected cross-references and terminology, updated affiliations and publication information, and a short Impact Statement.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is redrawn with additional comparator curves, changed function panels, extended axes, and removed speedup annotations. Figure 3 expands from two panels within one column to a full-width four-panel display. Figure 2 and Table 1 are relocated without substantive display changes.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects the foundational sphere-versus-ball smoothing mismatch and makes the previously abbreviated ZO-AdaMM convergence argument substantially more inspectable through Appendix A.10. Broader baseline comparisons, the LLM momentum test, and a clearer variance-dominant qualification strengthen validation and claim precision. These gains outweigh the lost Ackley coverage, although COPA-specific reproduction details remain missing.
